description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 21.12.2015 to 27.12.2015
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs valuation and rescinds a previous notification, making it a clear example of legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and compliance requirements for international trade.
